lead: Climate change continues to impact various sectors, from agriculture to energy consumption, with new research and innovative solutions emerging.

stories.title: Farmed salmon may not be as nutritious as it once was, new research suggests
stories.summary: Recent research indicates that the nutritional value of farmed salmon is declining, primarily due to changes in their diet. This shift not only affects the fish's health but also has broader environmental implications, raising concerns about sustainability and climate impact. The findings highlight the interconnectedness of food production and climate change.

stories.title: The best fans to keep you cool in 2026 – tried and tested
stories.summary: As summer heatwaves become more frequent and intense, finding effective cooling solutions is essential. This guide reviews the best fans available, promoting them as a more energy-efficient alternative to air conditioning, which contributes to carbon emissions. The article emphasizes the importance of reducing electricity use to combat climate change.

stories.title: Relax, everyone: Elon Musk has a mantra to make the climate crisis go away
stories.summary: Elon Musk proposes a radical solution to the climate crisis based on the Kardashev scale, suggesting that moving energy production off-planet could be the key to overcoming environmental challenges. This perspective reflects a broader trend where tech billionaires propose grandiose solutions to complex issues, often overshadowing more immediate, practical actions needed to address climate change.
